entries.title: Isaiah 24:1
segments: ¶Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty and makes it waste, Distorts its surface And scatters abroad its inhabitants.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:2
segments: And it shall be: As with the people, so with the priest; As with the servant, so with his master; As with the maid, so with her mistress; As with the buyer, so with the seller; As with the lender, so with the borrower; As with the creditor, so with the debtor.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:3
segments: The land shall be entirely emptied and utterly plundered, For the LORD has spoken this word.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:4
segments: The earth mourns [and] fades away, The world languishes [and] fades away; The haughty people of the earth languish.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:5
segments: The earth is also defiled under its inhabitants, Because they have transgressed the laws, Changed the ordinance, Broken the everlasting covenant.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:6
segments: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, And those who dwell in it are desolate. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, And few men [are] left.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:7
segments: The new wine fails, the vine languishes, All the merry-hearted sigh.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:8
segments: The mirth of the tambourine ceases, The noise of the jubilant ends, The joy of the harp ceases.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:9
segments: They shall not drink wine with a song; Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:10
segments: The city of confusion is broken down; Every house is shut up, so that none may go in.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:11
segments: [There is] a cry for wine in the streets, All joy is darkened, The mirth of the land is gone.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:12
segments: In the city desolation is left, And the gate is stricken with destruction.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:13
segments: ¶When it shall be thus in the midst of the land among the people, [It shall be] like the shaking of an olive tree, Like the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:14
segments: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing; For the majesty of the LORD They shall cry aloud from the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:15
segments: Therefore glorify the LORD in the dawning light, The name of the LORD God of Israel in the coastlands of the sea.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:16
segments: ¶From the ends of the earth we have heard songs: "Glory to the righteous!" But I said, "I am ruined, ruined! Woe to me! The treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously, Indeed, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously."

entries.title: Isaiah 24:17
segments: Fear and the pit and the snare [Are] upon you, O inhabitant of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:18
segments: And it shall be [That] he who flees from the noise of the fear Shall fall into the pit, And he who comes up from the midst of the pit Shall be caught in the snare; For the windows from on high are open, And the foundations of the earth are shaken.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:19
segments: The earth is violently broken, The earth is split open, The earth is shaken exceedingly.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:20
segments: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, And shall totter like a hut; Its transgression shall be heavy upon it, And it will fall, and not rise again.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:21
segments: It shall come to pass in that day [That] the LORD will punish on high the host of exalted ones, And on the earth the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:22
segments: They will be gathered together, [As] prisoners are gathered in the pit, And will be shut up in the prison; After many days they will be punished.

entries.title: Isaiah 24:23
segments: Then the moon will be disgraced And the sun ashamed; For the LORD of hosts will reign On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem And before His elders, gloriously.
